description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers building the message stack on locked positioning, lines diverging across surfaces, a missing audience-by-message matrix, and a German phrasing. Should-not covers the three neighbours the skill routes to (writing the copy, peer comparison, launch sequencing) plus one unrelated counterexample.

we shout one message at three audiences who hear three different things — build the matrix
wir brauchen eine Botschaftsarchitektur, keine weiteren Einzeltexte
write the homepage hero section now that the messages are agreed
